Methods (excerpt)

We performed all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of the apo and
ligand-bound forms of the kinase using the AMBER ff14SB force field for the
protein and the TIP3P model for water. The system was solvated in a cubic
box with at least 10 Å between the protein and any box edge, then neutralised
with 150 mM NaCl. After 5,000 steps of steepest-descent energy minimisation,
the system was equilibrated for 100 ps in the NVT ensemble at 300 K with
heavy-atom restraints (k = 1000 kJ mol⁻¹ nm⁻²) using a Langevin thermostat
(γ = 1 ps⁻¹). A second equilibration of 500 ps in the NPT ensemble at 1 bar
removed the restraints. Production simulations were run for 100 ns in the
NPT ensemble with a 2 fs time step and bonds to hydrogen constrained
(SHAKE). Coordinates were saved every 10 ps; energies and temperature every
1 ps. RMSD of Cα atoms was used as the primary stability metric.
